The Vikings are planning to start Carson Wentz on MNF against the Bills, as Kyler Murray’s hamstring injury would limit his mobility. Murray could also make it worse by playing. When healthy, Wentz has thrived in Kevin O’Connell’s offense. Now, a shot at 1 of the NFL’s best.
